purpose: Focused regression proof for external review findings V092-CODE-01, V092-CODE-02, and V092-CODE-03.
proof_notes: The post-commit cleanup-pending path now returns a committed receipt and leaves durable residue recoverable instead of reporting an undifferentiated activation failure.
The receipt input digest is generated through the fallible canonical digest path rather than an empty-string fallback.
ProductionBirthdayStore documents the same-host local filesystem and advisory-lock assumption.
non_claims: No broad Rust suite was run for this focused remediation evidence.
This evidence does not claim network-filesystem safety; the store remains a same-host local-filesystem primitive.
